Cassette 1.6 improves search responsiveness and reduces work during playback startup.

### Improvements

- Search and search pagination use a dedicated worker, so a slow Home, collection, or radio request no longer holds them up.
- Catalog results can appear while Cassette schedules artwork and updates the disk cache. Search suggestions use a 250 ms debounce independent of the window refresh timer.
- Streaming cache misses skip reading the offline index. Native playback reuses its codec registry, allocates the PCM buffer on first use, and polls less frequently after playback ends.
- Release builds optimize the sign-in webview and its event loop for binary size.

### Downloads

- **Windows x64** · Run `cassette-windows-x64.exe`. YouTube Music sign-in requires Microsoft Edge WebView2.
- **macOS Apple Silicon** · Open `cassette-macos-arm64.dmg` and drag Cassette into Applications. The build is ad-hoc signed.
- **Linux x64** · On Ubuntu 24.04, run `sudo apt install ./cassette-linux-x64.deb`.

All packages bundle yt-dlp and QuickJS-NG.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ctrlcat0x/Cassette/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0)
